console.name: sanitizer
console.title: Sanitizer
console.description: The violations of the exchange sanitizer, with their stacks, the counts per rule, and the calls still pending

report.label: query
report.description: Whether to include the full report of each violation and the still pending warnings; without it only the fields and the counts, as the table of camel get sanitizer shows them

enabled.description: Whether the sanitizer is switched on: with profile dev, camel.sanitizer.enabled=true or @CamelSanitizer, never with profile prod

reason.description: Why the sanitizer is off (only when it is off)

calls.description: The calls of the processors of steps checked (only when it is on)

commits.description: The commits of consumers followed for rule R2 (only when R2 is checked)

total.description: The violations reported, also those past the first 1000 that are counted but not listed (only when it is on)

rules.description: The violations reported per rule, R1 and R2 (only when it is on)

kinds.description: The violations reported per kind, every kind (only when it is on)

rule.description: The rule the violation breaks: R1 (the callback of a step) or R2 (the commit of a consumer)

kind.description: The kind of violation, such as COMPLETED_TWICE or COMMIT_NEVER_RUN

title.description: The kind of violation in plain words, such as: callback called twice

routeId.description: The id of the route of the step (for R2 without a step, the route of the consumer)

stepId.description: The id of the step, such as process1 or to2 (for R2, the step that ran on the thread where it was found, only when there was one)

processor.description: The class name of the processor of the step, such as the processor or the bean of a user (only when it was found); for R2 the class of the commit

report.description: The full report of the violation, as logged: where it happened, the threads and their stacks, the class and message of what was thrown, and the usual fix (only with the report option)

violations.description: The violations, the first 1000 in the order they were reported (only when it is on)

pendingCalls.description: The calls of steps pending now, whose callback has not come yet (only when the still pending warning of R1 is on)

stillPending.description: The calls reported still pending: warnings, not violations (only when the still pending warning of R1 is on)

stillPendingWarnings.description: The still pending warnings, the first 1000 as logged (only when the still pending warning of R1 is on, and with the report option)
